role: production multi-user tenancy, isolation, persistence and load-balancing policy
invariant: Many users may use CACE concurrently, but every request, job, artifact, AI link, wallet capability, protein object, experiment and sandbox belongs to exactly one tenant/account context unless an explicit cross-tenant collaboration capability authorizes otherwise.

ranked_architectures.name: Shared stateless control plane + isolated per-tenant sandboxes
strengths: best balance of isolation, cost, scaling and operational simplicity
one signed CACE software image prevents per-user code drift
durable tenant state stays persistent while compute sandboxes can remain warm, scale out, suspend or resume
tenant-scoped queues support fair scheduling and backpressure
tradeoffs: requires strong tenant identity propagation and authorization at every private-service boundary
requires sandbox lifecycle management and durable storage separate from ephemeral workers

ranked_architectures.name: Per-tenant container namespace / pod set
strengths: good fit for larger Researcher/Enterprise tenants
tradeoffs: higher baseline overhead than shared warm-pool workers
cluster policy must prevent namespace escape and cross-tenant service discovery

ranked_architectures.name: Per-tenant microVM sandbox with suspend/resume
strengths: good fit for untrusted native/AI workloads and enterprise tenants
can preserve a durable logical instance while suspending idle compute
tradeoffs: GPU passthrough and high-density scheduling are more complex

ranked_architectures.name: Shared worker pool with per-job tenant sandbox
strengths: good for short stateless scientific jobs
tradeoffs: larger shared-worker blast radius than dedicated tenant sandboxes
requires particularly strong filesystem/network/cgroup isolation and cleanup

ranked_architectures.name: Always-on full VM per user
strengths: simple mental model and strong isolation
tradeoffs: slow provisioning and inefficient idle capacity

logical_instance.rule: Each account owns a durable logical CACE instance_id. Do not clone the repository/source tree per user.
logical_instance.shared_code: All tenants execute an immutable signed/versioned CACE image or release artifact.
logical_instance.persistence: Tenant state is durable and always addressable even when compute workers are stopped or rescheduled.
logical_instance.upgrade: Upgrade tenants by moving instance manifests to a reviewed immutable release version; never edit per-user code copies.

load_balancing: stateless HTTP requests may route to any healthy gateway
WebSocket connections may use connection affinity while authoritative state remains external
rate limits and quotas are tenant-aware

control_plane.rule: Control-plane services never execute arbitrary customer scientific code.

private_execution_plane.sandbox_identity: Every worker receives a short-lived tenant_id + instance_id + job_id capability scoped to one operation.
isolation: separate filesystem workspace or mount namespace
worker_modes: warm tenant sandbox for interactive low-latency work
ephemeral per-job sandbox for burst scientific workloads
microVM tier for higher-risk or enterprise isolation
isolated exact-head proof runner outside ordinary tenant workers

tenant_data.relational: Every tenant-owned row has an authoritative tenant_id and server-enforced tenant filter/RLS-equivalent control.
tenant_data.object_storage: Tenant-prefixed namespaces plus tenant-scoped authorization; no client-chosen arbitrary storage path.
tenant_data.encryption: Encryption at rest with platform-managed keys; optional tenant-specific envelope keys for higher isolation tiers.
tenant_data.cache: Cache keys include release identity + tenant visibility scope + semantic input identity; private tenant cache entries never leak cross-tenant data.
tenant_data.backups: Tenant-aware backup/restore and account deletion/export procedures.

local_network_linking.rule: A user's local CACE/AI instance initiates an outbound authenticated connection to the public gateway/broker; production does not require inbound ports opened on the user's home/office network.
local_network_linking.pairing: Existing directional receive/outgoing pairing-code policy binds the local instance to the correct tenant/account.
local_network_linking.transport: Long-lived mutually authenticated outbound session or equivalent brokered channel, with reconnect/resume and heartbeats.
local_network_linking.routing: The central broker routes only tenant-authorized economy/heartbeat messages; local private services are never exposed publicly.
local_network_linking.offline_behavior: Local instance remains usable offline for supported local work and reconciles allowed state after reconnect.

always_up_semantics.rule: The user-facing CACE instance is logically always available even when dedicated compute is not continuously running.
always_up_semantics.durable_services: Account, metadata, experiments, help, results, provenance and job state remain persistent.
always_up_semantics.compute_policy: Interactive tenants may have a warm sandbox; idle compute may hibernate and resume automatically.
always_up_semantics.reconnect: Gateway can reconnect a browser or local agent to the durable instance after worker replacement/restart.
high_availability: idempotent job dispatch and resumable long-running jobs where practical

scheduler: weighted fair queueing or equivalent starvation-resistant scheduling
backpressure instead of unbounded queue growth
resource-class aware placement for CPU/GPU/high-memory/proof jobs
priority cannot alter scientific verification truth

forbidden: implicit cache sharing of private data

production_acceptance: concurrent-user load test proves horizontal gateway/API scaling
tenant-isolation negative tests prove one tenant cannot read/write another tenant's experiments, proteins, wallet capabilities or job state
sandbox escape and cross-tenant network tests fail closed
worker termination/replacement does not lose durable tenant state
idle sandbox suspend/resume preserves logical instance continuity
queue fairness test prevents one tenant from starving others
local-agent reconnect test requires no inbound port on user network
rolling release upgrade moves tenant instances without per-user source-code drift
scientific/proof/evidence semantics remain identical under load balancing
